chunks.text: I'll be singing, It's the Hard-Knock Life!

pieces.title: My Line
pieces.intro: This is the orphans' line. Miss Hannigan just woke them up, and it is still dark outside!
pieces.tip: Rub your eyes and say it like you are so, so sleepy. Then say Yes, Miss Hannigan, slow and grumpy.

chunks.text: Oh my goodness, oh my goodness.

pieces.title: My Song
pieces.intro: These are the words to the orphans' song. First we say them like a chant, then we sing them with the orphans.
pieces.tip: Sing it strong, like you are scrubbing the floor! Stomp your foot when you sing hard knock.

chunks.text: It's the hard-knock life for us! It's the hard-knock life for us!

songCut.note: The audition chorus inside the Sony 'Full Clip' audio (3:41.9). Times found by analysis, not by ear: Parent Corner lets a grown-up check and nudge them.

others.intro: This is Annie's line. Annie finds a scared little dog.
others.tip: Say it kindly, like you are talking to a scared puppy.

chunks.text: Are the dog catchers after you?
I ain't gonna let them get you or me.

others.intro: This is Grace's line. Grace works for a very rich man.
others.tip: Stand tall and say it clearly, like a grown-up at work.

chunks.text: to spend the holidays at his home.

others.intro: This is Mister Warbucks's line. He is surprised the orphan is a girl.
others.tip: Use a big, deep, bossy voice.

chunks.text: Oh well, I suppose she'll have to do.
I guess we should do something special on your first night.
Would you like to go to a movie?

others.intro: This is Miss Hannigan's line. She is very bossy to the orphans.
others.tip: Put your hands on your hips and be very, very bossy!

chunks.text: you'll all get down on your knobby little knees
until it shines like the top of the Chrysler Building!

others.intro: This is Rooster's line. Rooster is Miss Hannigan's sneaky brother.
others.tip: Be sneaky and sly, like a fox.

chunks.text: That kid is livin' in the lap of luxury
I wanna be on Easy Street!

others.intro: This is Lily's line. Lily is Rooster's fancy friend.
others.tip: Say it in a big, fancy, showy voice.

chunks.text: I heard about that orphan of yours, Annie.

others.intro: This is Bundles's line. Bundles brings the laundry.
others.tip: Be cheerful and loud, like you are calling down the hall.

chunks.say: whether you need um or not.
